plan.summary: BRO-5805: seven Talkin' Broadway reviews wrongly excluded by automatic content checks. Cleared the flag on the six that read as real reviews of the right show (Dog Day Afternoon, Caroline MCC, My Joy Is Heavy, Marcel on the Train, Making a Show of Myself, The Dinosaurs), deleted the 2021 Caroline, or Change file that is a different show, and recorded why Public Charge stays excluded.
